name: Urza's Saga — chapter abilities are granted, no false effects
notes: Memories: project_urzas_saga_fixes_2026-04-23 and project_urzas_saga_quoted_colon_isInActivated_2026-05-31. With two lore counters added the Saga has gained '{T}: Add {C}.' (chapter I) and the Construct-making ability (chapter II). The quoted colons used to be misread as the Saga's own activated abilities or skip the gain entirely, and the Construct token's 'gets +1/+1' text used to leak out as a global P/T boost.

$includes: {2}, {T}: Create a 0/0 colorless Construct artifact creature token with 'This token gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.'
